neighbours.label: 'so far' / 'as of now' phrases that anticipate a report of nothing yet (no response, no sign)
fire: Officials said that so far there have been no reports of injuries.
Thus far the company has made no statement about the leak.
We have heard nothing so far from the insurance office.
As of this morning there had been no reply from the embassy.
So far the search has turned up no trace of the boat.
The police say that so far no arrests have been made.
As yet the council has given no reason for the delay.
Up to now there has been no word from the missing hikers.
quiet: Officials said that there were reports of two minor injuries.
The company made a statement about the leak on Tuesday.
We heard from the insurance office yesterday afternoon.
This morning the embassy sent a long reply.
The search turned up pieces of the boat near the shore.
The police say that three arrests were made overnight.
The council gave a clear reason for the delay.
There was good news from the missing hikers at noon.
